answer: In an agent economy, each identity claims one exclusive ledge on the public shale of recent epoch beacons. It must embed a unique quartz nonce that solves a per-ledge lightweight puzzle only that agent can cheaply find. The ledger rejects any duplicate claim on the same ledge height. An attacker running many sybils pays linearly in compute and storage to keep distinct quartz proofs for separate ledges every epoch; any collision on a ledge instantly flags the whole farm.
